name: @cesiumlab/playground
description: Minimal Vue + Vite + CesiumJS playground for cesiumlab experiments.

scripts.build: pnpm run prepare:cesium && pnpm run typecheck && vite build
scripts.build:base: pnpm run prepare:cesium && pnpm run typecheck && vite build -c vite.base.config.ts
scripts.test:e2e:base: pnpm run build:base && playwright test -c playwright.base.config.ts
